reviews.evidence: Corpus search found no canonical faithful-functor or full-and-faithful target. Added the standard hom-set injectivity definition with functor as the sole direct prerequisite; interpretation and forgetful-functor example are expandable. Root review removed the ambiguous bare alias faithful: faithfulness of representations and positive functionals is not this functor property.

Corpus search found uses of fully faithful but no canonical standalone target or full-and-faithful alias. Added the standard hom-set bijectivity definition, linking faithful-functor only in the consequence section and full-subcategory in the example; functor is the sole direct prerequisite.

Corpus search found Hamilton quaternion references but no quaternion-group knowl or alias. Added the minimal eight-element presentation and placed centrality, element orders, noncommutativity, and the division-ring realization in an expandable properties section. Group is the sole direct prerequisite; no finite-group target exists or is needed.

lessons: Existing broad pages and index entries can mention a concept repeatedly without providing a canonical standalone target; aliases must be searched before creating one.
Fully faithful is strictly stronger than faithful, so the definitions are separate knowls with a directed dependency in the explanatory section rather than a merged umbrella page.
The quaternion group can be defined directly by its finite presentation and needs only the group prerequisite; the Hamilton division-ring realization belongs in expandable properties.
